learning_outcomes.text: The topic gives overview of all existing transmission types. The focus is given to transmissions of motor vehicles, but briefly are described also the gearboxes used in transport devices and planes.

syllabus_topics: Friction elements in transmissions (dry clutches, synchronizers, multi-plate clutches/brakes)
Automatic and two-clutch gearboxes of motor vehicles
Transmissions with power flow split and their applications
